problem.title: Maximum Average Subarray
problem.statement: Given an array of numbers and a number k, find the contiguous subarray of length exactly k with the largest average. Return the average value.
problem.hint: When the window length is fixed at k, you do not need to re-sum all elements each time it slides. Just add the incoming element and subtract the outgoing one.
problem.walkthrough:
Example array [1, 12, -5, -6, 50, 3] and k=4.

First window: [1, 12, -5, -6]. Sum = 2. Average = 0.5.
Slide right: exit 1, enter 50. Sum = 2 - 1 + 50 = 51. Average = 12.75.
Slide right again: exit 12, enter 3. Sum = 51 - 12 + 3 = 42. Average = 10.5.

Answer: 12.75.

Key insight: do not re-sum from scratch! Just compute the delta: current sum - outgoing + incoming. This makes the solution fast (linear, not quadratic).
problem.solution:
def max_average(nums, k):
    total = sum(nums[:k])
    best = total / k
    for i in range(k, len(nums)):
        total += nums[i] - nums[i - k]
        best = max(best, total / k)
    return best
